suppress.notes: Context: Testcontainers 2.0.5 hardcodes docker-java-transport-zerodep 3.7.1, whose shaded HttpCore 5.3.6 is affected by CVE-2026-54399 and CVE-2026-54428. Decision: accept only the test-scoped local-Docker denial-of-service exposure until upstream embeds HttpCore 5.4.3 or newer. Reason: the transport is test infrastructure, is absent from production artifacts, and cannot be replaced without forking Testcontainers. Revisit: adapstory-cw6y2, remove immediately after a fixed upstream release and no later than 2026-09-30.
